WITH per_item_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.order_item_id,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL 
        AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL 
        AND ili.derived_total_cost != 0
      THEN ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost
    END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(ili.order_item_id) as line_item_count
  FROM Order_Items oi
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_average_ratio,
  AVG(line_item_count) as average_line_items_per_order_item
FROM per_item_stats
WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: Division by zero is prevented: rows where derived_total_cost is NULL or 0 are excluded from ratio calculation
Order items with no valid ratios (no invoice line items, or all items missing cost data) are excluded from both final aggregations
The line_item_count per order item includes all invoice line items, not just those with valid cost data

alternatives.interpretation: The average line items per order item should include all order items, even those with no valid ratios, while the ratio average excludes those without valid ratios
